name: Palladous-Doxology
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near towering mountain ranges.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Approach protocols for automated beacon of unknown purpose are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
Whoever controls carbon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
